items.title: Eddie Metz Jr. interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, October 3, 2015
items.q: The transcript identifies Monk Rowe as the interviewer ('[INTERVIEWER] My name is Monk Rowe') and the interviewee as Eddie Metz Jr. There is no dialogue or narrative indicating a personal, professional, or musical relationship between them beyond the interview context.

ctx.x: Eddie was interviewed in New Hartford, NY on October 3, 2015 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe and I’m meeting with Eddie Metz Jr. today, a short twelve hours after an awesome gig last night at Hamilton — 9 A.M. for a jazz musician.
Yeah. That’s okay. I don’t do most of the things I used to do, that kept me from waking up in the morning. I get older and wiser I guess.
